tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by seven different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI tests third-party access to its artificial intelligence monitoring system, patching novel vulnerabilities in a pilot with METR and Redwood. Confirmed by CNBC.
DeepSeek raises 15 billion dollars amid US security restrictions, signaling rapid growth in China's artificial intelligence race. Confirmed by The Tech Portal.
Polarise launches sovereign artificial intelligence cloud in Europe for enterprise artificial intelligence with full data control. Confirmed by Easy News Press Agency.
SpaceX launches artificial intelligence partner network with enterprises to co-develop artificial intelligence-powered solutions. Confirmed by xAI.
1Password launches artificial intelligence agent login tool with Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic and SpaceX integrations. Confirmed by The Next Web.
Free every hour.
